metaDescription: Shop custom 16 oz bar wine glasses for events. Perfect for branding at weddings, parties, and corporate gatherings. Order bulk at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom 16 oz bar wine glasses hit the sweet spot between a standard pour and a generous serving. Whether you are branding a stemless wine tumbler for a tasting event or a durable plastic cup for an outdoor festival, this size gives guests room to enjoy without frequent refills. The 16 oz capacity works well for both red and white wines, and it pairs nicely with screen printing or engraving for a polished look. Choose from insulated stainless steel or shatterproof plastic options to match your venue and budget.
